listing.name: Quake 4 (Xbox 360 edition) (Xbox 360 Quake 4 decomp/recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows setup EXE builds game from user's ISO/default.xex, not a prebuilt playable game binary. Limits: Only early levels tested upstream; later levels rough and audio lightly tested. Setup/build route is substantial. Upstream platforms: Windows setup EXE/local compiler route; selected host CPU unknown in frozen evidence. D3D11 native renderer variant and legacy executable remain distinct outputs. Original data: User-owned Xbox 360 Quake 4 ISO; code generated locally. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
